changelog:
- Major refocus: The skill was simplified to provide a concise, step-by-step framework for referral and affiliate program design, and cleanly guides users through program selection, incentive structuring, mechanics, and promotion.
- All reference and framework files (including measurement-framework.md, program-mechanics.md, and referral_roi_calculator.py) were removed; details are now streamlined into a single onboarding flow.
- Skill instructions updated for broader audience—includes easy discovery questions, tailored action plan, recommended resources, and direct links for further reading.
- Previous in-depth technical and optimization content replaced by high-level, actionable guidance with emphasis on practical implementation for startups and SaaS founders.
summary: Designs referral and affiliate program structure for startups. Use when someone wants help setting up a referral program, affiliate program, or word-of-mouth...
